name: G7 Frog Porridge & Live Seafood
description: 芽笼知名的老牌海鲜与田鸡粥餐厅，招牌宫保田鸡和姜葱田鸡肉质鲜嫩，酱汁浓郁，搭配绵密的砂煲白粥是绝佳的宵夜选择，同时也提供辣椒螃蟹等丰富的本地特色煮炒海鲜。
descriptionEn: A well-known heritage seafood and frog porridge restaurant in Geylang. The signature Kung Pao frog and ginger-scallion frog are tender with rich sauce, paired perfectly with creamy claypot rice porridge — a great late-night supper. Also serves chilli crab and other local zi-char seafood dishes.
recommendNote: 冲着田鸡粥来的老饕别只顾着吃田鸡，红烧鳄鱼尾也是这里的隐藏王牌——皮糯肉嫩，酱汁浓香入味，胆子大的一定要试试。
recommendNoteEn: If you're here for the frog porridge, don't stop there — the braised crocodile tail is a hidden gem too: chewy skin, tender meat, rich savory sauce. Adventurous eaters, give it a go.

restaurantFeatures.reservationDifficulty: 高峰期或多人聚餐建议提前预订，平时可直接前往
restaurantFeatures.reservationDifficultyEn: Reservations recommended during peak hours or for large groups; walk-ins fine otherwise
